items.summary: Legal disposition: conditional for ordinary reversible fleet growth; blocked for the gated product's public beta or full launch; counsel_required for upstream data rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, vendor/DPA obligations, and future affiliate or advertising use. Evidence: compliance is a technical baseline only with 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown sites; open findings include banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms gaps. Analytics is broadly available but has permission/configuration failures; incomplete telemetry is not itself a growth blocker. Revenue covers 2026-09-21 only with $4.92 aggregate commission and $0 site-attributed commission, so ROI, margin, and financial claims remain unsupported. Exact decision: keep the gated product private and continue only bounded read-only evidence work plus ordinary reversible growth that preserves consent, cookie/analytics disclosure, terms, affiliate disclosure, claims, provenance, rights, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and regulated or age-sensitive boundaries.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks are closed. Partial progress is evidenced by official source documentation and terms, repository/configuration data-flow files, privacy and cookie pages, and draft terms. No task is closable because authoritative rights, field-level provenance, operator-confirmed retention and user workflows, deployed consent and GA4 settings, log/vendor inventory, incident/request procedures, and human-counsel review remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, alert and operational data flows, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent and unsubscribe behavior, GA4 configuration and retention, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Keep external permission outreach unsent pending owner and human-counsel authorization.

Data-use review dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data = blocked; current API documentation establishes access mechanics but not rights to fetch, store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, use images/prices/trademarks, or monetize. Missing written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance and rights, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, and affiliate/advertising limits. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel and owner review. User alert rules and sync results = evidence_needed; missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce the repository/deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics = evidence_needed; missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data = evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA review, incident handling, and data-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.

Do not close fleet compliance, data-quality, analytics, revenue, site, or launch-readiness gates from aggregate evidence. Preserve unknowns: site-specific compliance failures and network-unknown checks require remediation or evidence; analytics permission errors are data-quality issues and do not automatically block ordinary growth; the Amazon aggregate revenue row must remain unassigned; domain names and portfolio labels do not establish adult status, age suitability, regulated-use compliance, claims support, copyright/trademark clearance, data provenance, or platform-policy compliance. Continue existing measurement, failure repair-or-close review, bounded security evidence, and private launch-gate work only; create no new production work, duplicate telemetry request, spend, monetization expansion, or external outreach.
